Karnataka, Rosewood Inlay (Kundana Kale) is a meticulous art form practiced primarily in the royal city of Mysuru. Artisans skillfully carve intricate designs into the dark, lustrous surface of rosewood, scooping out shallow patterns with precision. Into these carved spaces, they inlay slivers of naturally coloured woods, piecing together vivid landscapes, historic events, and mythological scenes."],"extra":["Care Tips: Apply mansion polish and rub with soft dry cloth for a shiny look.
